# cpa-workpaper-spec

> Open JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) and OpenAPI vocabulary for CPA engagements:
> engagements, workpapers, monthly-close checklists with the open-items loop,
> tax-prep stage models, engagement-letter config, and request-list (PBC) items.
> A firm-agnostic interchange spec for describing this work so two systems can
> exchange it. Normative rules in SPEC.md; schemas in schema/v0.1/.

Validator: `python validator/validate.py` (needs `pip install -r requirements.txt`).

## Validator CLI

- `validate.py <doc.json|-> --schema <name> [--json]` : validate one document (stdin with `-`).
- `validate.py --all [--json]` : validate every bundled example.
- `validate.py --list-schemas [--json]` : list known schema names.
- Schema names: engagement, workpaper, close-checklist, tax-prep, engagement-letter, request-list-item.

## JSON output and exit codes

- `--json` on a single doc: `{ok, valid, schema, document, errors}`.
- Exit codes: 0 all valid, 1 a document is invalid, 2 usage/input error.

## Agent notes

- Fully offline; deterministic. There is also a JavaScript/Ajv validator in `validator-js/`.
- Backs the `validate_workpaper` tool in maxed-mcp (set CPA_WORKPAPER_SPEC_DIR).
- See AGENT.md for the full machine interface.
